_source.kind: hand-written minimal sample following the official Go client's Device type for GET /api/v2/tailnet/{tailnet}/devices (an object with a `devices` array)
_source.note: Read on 2026-11-12: base URL https://api.tailscale.com, '-' is the default tailnet, the client authenticates with HTTP Basic using the API key as user name and an empty password, and the response is {"devices": [...]}. The public API pages did not render server-side, so field names come from the vendor's client source. Not recorded from a live tailnet.
